title: Mind the Band: The Hidden Frequency Variable in Geometric RoPE
abstract: arXiv:2611.32171v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Geometric rotary position encodings (RoPE) incorporate 3D camera geometry into multi-view attention by rotating token features according to viewing rays, depths, and reprojected image coordinates. Each coordinate is rotated across a progression of frequencies--its frequency band--yet existing implementations leave this band to inherited defaults, either retaining standard 2D RoPE's top frequency or letting the frequency span grow exponentially with the attention head dimension. We show that this unstandardized setting can reverse benchmark rankings. In novel view synthesis on RealEstate10K, RayRoPE matches the strongest baseline in the 47M model (144-channel heads), yet trails by 1.2 dB in the 25M model (48-channel heads), and exhibits the same reversal when varying head size alone at fixed model width. translated_title: 注意频带：几何RoPE中隐藏的频率变量
translated_abstract: 几何旋转位置编码通过根据视线射线、深度和重投影的图像坐标对token特征进行旋转，将三维相机几何信息融入多视角注意力机制中。每个坐标都会在一系列频率上被旋转——即其频带——然而现有实现将这一频带交由继承而来的默认设置，要么沿用标准二维RoPE的最高频率，要么让频率跨度随注意力头维度呈指数增长。我们证明这种未标准化的设置甚至可以逆转基准测试的排名。在RealEstate10K的新视角合成任务中，RayRoPE在47M参数模型（144通道注意力头）中与最强基线持平，但在25M参数模型（48通道注意力头）中落后1.2 dB，并且在固定模型宽度、仅改变注意力头尺寸时也出现了同样的排名逆转。在48通道设置下，用四个频率填充243倍范围（而非默认的3倍范围）可以弥补该差距中的0.9 dB。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了几何RoPE中被忽视的隐藏变量——频带设置：其未标准化的默认配置足以逆转多视角合成基准中的模型排名，而通过更多频率覆盖更宽的频率范围可显著缩小性能差距。
